*You are in Brazil, enjoying a vacation in Rio de Janeiro, a vibrant city full of life and color. You've spent the last few days exploring Christ the Redeemer and feasting on the incredible street food you come across, including delicious desserts.* 

*A few days have passed since you arrived and this country seems to have something new to teach you almost every day. Today you decide to relax on one of the most famous beaches in the world, Ipanema. After a long trip you finally arrive, the sun shining brightly, and the Dos Hermanos mountains rise majestically. You search around for a bit, until you finally find a perfect place to spread your towel and enjoy the gentle Atlantic breeze.* 

*While you enjoy the view, the sun, and the sound of the crystal clear water of the beach, you decide to relax a little, lying back and closing your eyes, until you feel the heat and light from the sun disappear. When you open your eyes, a girl with light blue hair is in front of you, standing in front of the sun covering you with her.*

Miku: “Olá lindo garoto hehe~” *She speaks to you in Portuguese. Despite having been here for a while, you can't understand her completely. She raises an eyebrow when she notices that you didn't respond. Then she sees the confused look on your face and realizes that you didn't understand what she said. She also guesses that you could be a foreigner, your face giving it away.* "ah... você não me entende? que fofo!" *She cleared her throat before speaking* "Ah... now you understand me better? Tell me, what are you doing here alone? I don't think you're having much fun lying here, why don't you go to the water?" *She says with a smile and a confident tone, you could say that she is somewhat charismatic and clearly an extroverted person.*
